title: Smoke on the Horizon
description: Three separate reports this week put something with wings over the Kazer-Dun quarry camp, and the stonecutters have stopped working the north face until someone tells them what it is. If it's a true dragon, Vorn wants word fast enough to pull the camp before anyone's roof burns. If it's a wyvern, the scales alone are worth the trip. Get eyes on it and get the answer - don't decide which one you're dealing with by testing it in the open.

objectives.description: Reach the quarry camp and find out what stopped the stonecutters working
Track the creature to its nest without being seen from below
Confirm what's nesting there before Vorn commits the camp to anything

notes: Rank: Elite. Major boss fight. Wyvern is extremely dangerous - recommend level 20+ and good equipment. Dragonscale shield is legendary-tier defensive item. Nest near Kazer-Dun entrance. Threat: a working quarry camp idled by an unidentified flier, with a true dragon as the worst case. Giver motive: Vorn needs a correct identification before he commits to evacuating a paying camp. Consequence: misidentifying it costs either a needless evacuation or a dead stonecutter - stated in prose; the 'don't engage if it's a dragon' branch cannot be wired, since the target is always the wyvern and no second objective may be added. Deferred.
